notes.title: Added 15 new pictures
notes.content:
The number of sold copies of [b]Coloring Game: Girls 2[/b] for the first weekend, 1.5 times higher than for the same period of the first part. 
Based on the results of these sales, several decisions have been made.

[h3]The number of pictures has been increased by 1.5 times[/h3]
15 new pictures have been added to the game. Five more pictures will be added on February 21.
[b]UPD: The update will be released on February 22.[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45220088/91d81d83b17e76929618e2be93f77ec1790547d3.png[/img]


[h2]Coloring Game: Girls 3[/h2]
The decision has been made to create and release CG: Girls 3. 
A game page will be unveiled in March, with a tentative release date of July 2025.

notes.title: Minor update 1.0.1
notes.content:
[b]- Increased the speed of Joe by two times.[/b]

[b]- Added possibility to deactivate achievement and status of the passed level.[/b]

To do this in the main menu, select the level you want and press the key combination Ctrl+Shift+D.
This operation does not affect the progress of painted pixels itself.

Unfortunately, in the first 10 minutes after the release for downloading the game was available debug version in which all levels were passed, which when selecting a level immediately activated achievements. If someone managed to download this version, you can use this feature to deactivate levels that were not passed.
